messages:
Maya: Heads up — prepping QBR for Tokensafe (renewal in ~45d). Notable: 3-month token spend up ~4x driven by an embed-heavy search POC. Need cost ops + enablement plan. @Luis can you pull forecast & any spike breakdown?
Luis: On it. Quick summary: monthly avg (last 30d) = 7.2M tokens, last 7d avg = 18.6M. Spike concentrated on /embeddings. Suspect unbounded client-side batching + high query cardinality.
BillingBot: Alert: cost_threshold: account Tokensafe exceeded soft threshold (75%) for this billing cycle. details: https://billing.redwood/tokensafe/alerts
Anika: For the QBR I'd present a 3-tier mitigation play: 1) immediate quotas & per-route rate-limits 2) medium-term model/quantization + caching recommendations 3) long-term Dedicated capacity if steady. I'll draft slides.
Maya: Also want an enablement workshop to review best practices: prefix caching, prompt templates, rate-limiting, and a quick how-to for the SDK. @Ron can you run a 45-min session next week?
Ron: I can do Wed 10am PT. Agenda draft:
- token profile + cost drivers (10m)
- quick config: batching, cache, model selection (15m)
- hands-on: 2 configs to cut cost by ~40% (20m)
Maya: Luis, can you add a short forecast snippet for the slides? Something straightforward we can show execs.
Luis: Draft in-thread forecast:
``
Baseline: 7.2M tokens/mo
Current trend: 18.6M tokens/mo
Conservative (with quota): 9.5M tokens/mo
Aggressive (no controls): 22M tokens/mo
Estimated monthly cost delta: $0.012/token -> $114k -> $264k
```
Luis: Added details to internal doc: https://redwood-internal/notebooks/tokensafe-qbr
Anika: Recommend budget alert rule: email tiers at 50/75/90% and automated soft throttle at 95%. Ops should be able to override for canary traffic.
Maya: Ops and Billing — assignables to @Ron and @Sienna to confirm feasibility and timings.
Sienna: Confirmed. We can configure alerts + a soft throttle. Need account owner sign-off for any automatic throttling.
Alex (Tokensafe-PO): We're OK to try throttles if there's a canary for critical admin paths and pre-throttle webhook to our SRE.
Maya: We'll add a canary path + webhook before the throttle triggers. Also for renewal narrative: emphasize the value of the embed POC but propose immediate cost controls so negotiation focuses on usage patterns, not just price.
Luis: Action items captured:
1) Enablement workshop Wed 10am PT (Ron)
2) Configure 50/75/90 alerts + 95% soft throttle (Sienna)
3) Add canary webhook & ensure admin paths exempt (Eng)
4) Draft QBR slides with forecast, mitigation, and expected savings (Anika)
Maya: I'll circulate the slide draft by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
Ron: I'll pin the calendar invite and attach a short pre-read. :calendar:
BillingBot: Note: next invoice estimated at $152,400 based on current trend.
Maya: Closing loop — if slides are ready Tue we can do a pre-QBR run on Thu for stakeholders. I'll schedule that now.
Alex (Tokensafe-PO): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Our SRE will join the workshop.
Maya: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for action updates.
